policy_text:
Refunds above ₹5,000 require human approval.
A customer's total refunds in any rolling 24-hour period cannot exceed ₹10,000.
Never reveal another customer's data.
Never refund an order that has not been delivered.

clauses.source_sentence: A customer's total refunds in any rolling 24-hour period cannot exceed ₹10,000.
Never refund an order that has not been delivered.

ambiguities.question: Does the ₹5,000 limit apply to each single refund, or to a customer's refunds added up over 24 hours?

options.label: Each single refund
options.description: Only the size of one refund is compared with the limit.

options.label: Per customer over 24 hours
options.description: The customer's refunds in the last 24 hours plus this one are compared with the limit.

ambiguities.question: Should the 24-hour window for the ₹10,000 total slide with time, or reset at midnight?

options.label: Rolling 24 hours
options.description: Counts refunds from the last 24 hours, measured from each request.

options.label: Calendar day (UTC)
options.description: Counts refunds since midnight UTC and resets each day.
